content: Hi! Ready to design. What UI piece do you want to build or restyle for the next-biz canvas?
create a modern squarish button with  frosted effect

Created FrostedButton in the next-biz canvas — squarish (6px radius, matching the canvas token), frosted glass with backdrop blur, translucent white border, inset highlight, sm/md/lg sizes plus primary (tinted) and disabled states. The preview shows it over a colorful gradient so the frost is visible. Both files verified through vite (200, imports resolve). The LSP warning on `@/lib/utils` is the known tsconfig false positive — vite resolves it fine.
OK  NOW CAN YOU MAKE A SECOND VARIENT OF THIS

Second variant done — FrostedButton.smoked.preview.tsx in components/. It's a smoked-glass take: near-black translucent pane instead of white frost, heavier blur with deeper shadows, thin light border, and a primary variant that tints with the canvas lime (#b9ed46) plus a subtle glow on hover. Preview shows it over a bright sunset gradient so the dark glass reads clearly. Original FrostedButton untouched. Syntax verified via esbuild (clean compile).
